title: VPN Pulse collectors map (private file on the monitoring host)
description: How the loop reaches each server's read-only helper. This file names hosts and key paths, so it lives next to the secrets (0600) and never in the public configuration; config.yaml refers to an entry by `servers[].collector_ref`. No secrets here either — only paths to them.

kind.description: what the helper on that server reads; informational here — the helper's own config decides

host.description: hostname, address or an alias from the monitoring user's ssh config

key_file.description: the collector's private key for this server only (0600); made by `vpn-pulse collector keygen`

known_hosts_file.description: the pinned host key of this server (`vpn-pulse collector pin`); StrictHostKeyChecking=yes
